articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Europol follows $28.5M crypto trail in streaming piracy crackdown
articles.description: Authorities from 11 countries worked with Binance, Coinbase and Chainalysis to trace financial transactions and disrupt illegal streaming services.

articles.title: In all-hands meeting, Jensen Huang thanks White House and says he’s in therapy
articles.description: The Nvidia founder apologized to his staff on Tuesday and said he was grateful for a second chance to lead the company.

articles.title: Even the best AI agents struggle with everyday life
articles.description: As millions embrace personal AI assistants, a new benchmark reveals that even the most advanced AI models struggle to complete everyday tasks reliably and safely without introducing potential new problems.

articles.title: Walmart teams up with Meta to bring Black Friday deals to AI agent Muse
articles.description: Walmart now lets customers shop Black Friday deals through Muse, Meta’s AI agent.

articles.title: Maple raises $5.3M to build AI products that protect your data, even from itself
articles.description: The startup's encrypted AI architecture is designed to prevent even the company itself from accessing users' private data.

articles.title: Utah moves to dismiss criminal charges against Kalshi after trading halt
articles.description: Utah’s attorney general warned that the criminal charges could be refiled if Kalshi resumes operations in the state, while separate civil litigation remains unresolved.

articles.title: Bitcoin sell-off driven by weak demand, forced liquidations: 21Shares
articles.description: The crypto asset manager warned that Bitcoin’s downturn could persist amid weak investor demand, while forecasting an uneven recovery across crypto sectors.

articles.title: Coldcard reveals how Bitcoin wallet flaw went undetected for over 5 years
articles.description: Coldcard maker Coinkite explained why years of security checks failed to catch the flaw and said it has yet to decide on compensation for affected customers.

articles.title: CFTC sets new prediction market rules as more firms seek US entry
articles.description: The US regulator has approved permanent reporting rules for certain event contracts as more companies look to launch prediction markets.

articles.title: Anthropic shares fall below IPO price, a worrying sign for AI startups
articles.description: Anthropic’s post-IPO slump could put pressure on AI startup valuations.

articles.title: BlackRock launches tokenized money market fund accepting stablecoins in Hong Kong
articles.description: The tokenized fund launched with approximately $100 million in assets, with Standard Chartered and Ant International participating as seed investors.

articles.title: UK warns AI-driven cyberattacks are exposing years of weak security
articles.description: The British cyber agency says that "building strong foundations has never mattered more" as AI hacking tools rely on exploiting simple security flaws.

articles.title: Utah moves to drop criminal pursuit of Kalshi after the firm halted services there
articles.description: The state continues to hold the criminal charges in its back pocket with a vow to hit Kalshi and other prediction markets with gambling accusations if they return.

articles.title: Electric truck startup Harbinger gets financing boost from Palmer Luckey’s bank
articles.description: Harbinger has tapped Palmer Luckey's Erebor Bank as a new source of capital as the electric truck startup looks to diversify how it funds its growth.

articles.title: Bitcoin slides amid US tariff nerves as Anthropic falls below IPO price
articles.description: Bitcoin gave up gains above $60,000 as tariff concerns weighed on US stocks and Anthropic shares hit new lows below $76.

articles.title: Meta brings its Muse AI assistant directly into Instagram DMs
articles.description: The new integration gets rid of the need for users to toggle between Instagram and the Muse app when they want to interact with the AI agent.

articles.title: Tidal to ban and remove millions of AI-generated tracks as AI slop inundates music streaming
articles.description: The company said it will still accept songs that were made with AI assistance, but not fully generated.

articles.title: How South Korea’s proposed 20% cap could change who runs Upbit
articles.description: Naver Financial agreed to buy every share in Upbit’s operator, but a proposed ownership cap could strip away its voting rights on four-fifths of them.

articles.title: Why a Crusoe investor is betting on solar and batteries to power future AI data centers
articles.description: Next-generation data centers will need tens of gigawatts of power every year. One of Crusoe's investors thinks solar and energy storage are the obvious choice.
